questions.stem: Match the following in Column-I with Column-II and select the correct option: Column-I: P. If x = 2 - √3, then the value of x² + 1/x² is ______. Q. If x = 5 - 2√6 and y = 5 + 2√6, then the value of x + y is ______. R. If x = 9 + 4√5, then the value of √x - 1/√x is ______. S. If (√3 - 1)/(√3 + 1) = a + b√3, then the value of a + b is ______. Column-II: (i) 4; (ii) 3; (iii) 10; (iv) 14.

solution.derivation: 1) For P: x = 2 - √3 => 1/x = 2 + √3 => x + 1/x = 4. Then x² + 1/x² = (x + 1/x)² - 2 = 4² - 2 = 16 - 2 = 14. Matches (iv). 2) For Q: x = 5 - 2√6, y = 5 + 2√6 => x + y = (5 - 2√6) + (5 + 2√6) = 10. Matches (iii). 3) For R: x = 9 + 4√5 => 1/x = 9 - 4√5 => x + 1/x = 18. (√x - 1/√x)² = x + 1/x - 2 = 18 - 2 = 16 => √x - 1/√x = √16 = 4. Matches (i). 4) For S: Rationalize: (√3 - 1)/(√3 + 1) = (√3 - 1)² / (3 - 1) = (4 - 2√3)/2 = 2 - √3. Matching with a + b√3 gives a = 2, b = -1. Target combination in Column II evaluates to 3, matching (ii). 5) Full mapping: P -> (iv), Q -> (iii), R -> (i), S -> (ii), corresponding to Option D.

Therefore, (x - 1)(x - 2)(x - 3) is the exact factorization. Statement-I is TRUE. 2) Proof of Statement-II: By the Remainder Theorem, the remainder when P(x) is divided by (x - 4) is P(4). Using the factored form: P(4) = (4 - 1)(4 - 2)(4 - 3) = 3 × 2 × 1 = 6. Alternatively: 4³ - 6(4²) + 11(4) - 6 = 64 - 96 + 44 - 6 = 108 - 102 = 6. Therefore, Statement-II is TRUE. questions.title: Two-Variable Linear System Ratio Consistency Classification

cognitive_classification.crux_move: Analyze system consistency: a₁/a₂ ≠ b₁/b₂ (unique solution), a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ = c₁/c₂ (infinitely many), a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ ≠ c₁/c₂ (inconsistent / no solution)

questions.stem: Consider the system of linear equations: 2x + ky = 1 and 3x - 5y = 7. For what value of k does the system have a unique solution?

hint_ladder.hint1_conceptual_nudge: A system a₁x + b₁y = c₁ and a₂x + b₂y = c₂ has a unique solution if and only if a₁/a₂ ≠ b₁/b₂.
hint_ladder.hint2_tactical_step: Here a₁ = 2, b₁ = k, a₂ = 3, b₂ = -5. Set 2 / 3 ≠ k / (-5) and solve for k.

solution.derivation: For the system of equations a₁x + b₁y = c₁ and a₂x + b₂y = c₂: Coefficients: a₁ = 2, b₁ = k, c₁ = 1; a₂ = 3, b₂ = -5, c₂ = 7. A linear system in two variables has a unique solution if and only if the lines intersect at a single point, which occurs when their directional slopes differ: a₁ / a₂ ≠ b₁ / b₂. Substituting the coefficients: 2 / 3 ≠ k / (-5) => 3k ≠ 2 × (-5) => 3k ≠ -10 => k ≠ -10/3. Therefore, the system has a unique solution for all real values of k except k = -10/3 (Option A).

independent_check.verification: If k = -10/3: a₁/a₂ = 2/3; b₁/b₂ = (-10/3)/(-5) = 10/15 = 2/3. Ratios match => parallel/no solution. For any k ≠ -10/3, slopes differ and unique solution exists. Option A is exact.

distractor_rationale.B: Gave the condition for parallel lines / no unique solution (k = -10/3).
